what: Hovering one of several cells that share a group name (data-group) fades every cell of the other groups to .2 (.2s) — only the several screens of one work remain. Leaving is delayed by a beat so moving from cell to cell doesn’t release it, and everything returns when the pointer leaves the panel. Choosing something to hide along with it (like a header) makes that vanish in .25s too

options.hide: CSS selector of the elements to hide together (e.g. .site-head) — if empty, nothing is hidden
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Cell — group name goes in data-group
